commitments.detail: Submit a voluntary self-disclosure report to OFAC within 10 business days.
Implement enhanced screening controls for all future transactions involving the reseller.
Conduct a thorough review of the reseller's compliance with sanctions and trade regulations.
Take appropriate measures to manage and potentially return any blocked funds to their rightful owners.
Plan to wind down the reseller relationship over the next 30 days to mitigate further risk.
